selection: Prefer distinct mechanisms; 145093 and 204033 conservatively share one root group. Final admission requires reviewed repeated execution.

candidates.title: `scatter_add` / `scatter_reduce` on CPU write to the wrong rows when the index is expanded and self has more columns than the index
candidates.conditions: Expanded stride (1,0), index narrower than destination
candidates.framework_gap: Missing zero-stride representation sampler; layout MR currently allows only strided/offset.

candidates.title: [Autograd] Incorrect first-order gradient for torch.linalg.slogdet with conj().imag input
candidates.oracle: Analytic inverse transpose, scalar finite differences and resolve_neg control
candidates.framework_gap: Missing negative-bit transform and evidence; complex differentiable loss needs explicit real semantics.
candidates.expected_behavior: Analytic inverse transpose, scalar finite differences and resolve_neg control

candidates.title: CPU `torch.linalg.lu_solve` reads the wrong LU matrices when a size-1 batch dimension has a non-canonical stride (wrong results under nested `vmap` and `vmap(jacfwd)`)
candidates.conditions: Inserted size-one batch dimension with noncanonical stride
candidates.framework_gap: Sampler cannot request singleton-dimension stride; generic linalg capability certification missing.

candidates.title: @torch.autocast decorator leaks autocast state across overlapping calls
candidates.conditions: Recursive calls to same autocast decorator
candidates.oracle: Entry/exit full AMP-state invariant and fresh-context control
candidates.framework_gap: Program contract lacks general recursive context lifecycle and ambient AMP-state oracle.
candidates.expected_behavior: Entry/exit full AMP-state invariant and fresh-context control

candidates.title: torch.cuda.make_graphed_callables can silently corrupt parameter gradient accumulation by returning static grad buffers
candidates.root_group: CUDA graph static gradient buffer reuse
candidates.oracle: Analytic sum of inputs and eager autograd control
candidates.framework_gap: No CUDA graph capture/replay state transition.
candidates.expected_behavior: Analytic sum of inputs and eager autograd control

candidates.title: [Inductor] Fails to preserve aliasing between conjugate imaginary view and base tensor
candidates.conditions: Returned conjugate imaginary view subsequently mutated
candidates.oracle: Analytic mutation propagation and eager control
candidates.framework_gap: No post-return mutation probe or output alias contract.
candidates.expected_behavior: Analytic mutation propagation and eager control

candidates.title: Inductor aten.clone lowering ignores Conjugate and Negative dispatch keys
candidates.conditions: Negative view supplied to compiled clone
candidates.oracle: Sign identity and resolved-negative clone control
candidates.framework_gap: Grouped conservatively with 204033 pending evidence of independent cause.
candidates.exclusion: Conservatively grouped with selected 204033; not counted independently.

candidates.title: Complex `linalg.pinv` / `linalg.polar` / `linalg.matrix_sqrth` return wrong values under any `TorchDispatchMode` (hence under `torch.compile`): a conjugate view taken inside the ATen kernel is not applied
candidates.oracle: Elementary 2x2 inverse, inverse identity, and eager pinv control; explicit constant complex matrix
candidates.framework_gap: No profiling-mode state dimension or mathematical reference oracle.
candidates.screening_note: Screening used the earlier seeded-input fixture; no current fixed-input validation claimed.

candidates.title: [MKLDNN] BatchNorm produces incorrect results with non-contiguous weight and bias
candidates.conditions: MKLDNN inference input, stride-two affine tensors
candidates.oracle: Explicit normalization formula and contiguous-affine control
candidates.framework_gap: Dense registration possible with internal conversion; purity and specialized-layout evidence absent.
candidates.expected_behavior: Explicit normalization formula and contiguous-affine control

candidates.title: CSR `add(out=)` writes wrong values when `out`'s `values()` is non-contiguous
candidates.conditions: Valid CSR out with stride-two values storage
candidates.oracle: Elementwise scalar sums and contiguous-output control
candidates.framework_gap: Registered sparse inputs rejected; out= and collateral storage observables absent.
candidates.expected_behavior: Elementwise scalar sums and contiguous-output control

candidates.title: [inductor][cpu] `torch.std`/`var` accumulate in float32: inf/NaN for 1e30-scale inputs, and **zero output with an all-zero gradient** for 1e-30-scale inputs (eager and float64 are correct)
candidates.conditions: Compiled FP32 std on exactly representable tiny opposite values
candidates.framework_gap: No pure eager/compiled MR; global absolute tolerance masks tiny outputs but not O(1) gradients.

candidates.title: [Inductor] CUDA static: clone of a repeated-input cat reads a transposed source with destination row-major strides (silent wrong values)
candidates.conditions: Transposed broadcast operands, repeated cat, static compilation
candidates.framework_gap: No general eager/compiled equivalence MR with runtime graph evidence.
candidates.screening_note: Screening used the earlier seeded-input fixture; no current fixed-input validation claimed.

candidates.title: [ROCm] copy_ double-applies conjugate/negative view bits when broadcasting requires temporary staging
candidates.conditions: Blocking CPU-to-CUDA broadcasting of conjugate source
candidates.oracle: Explicit complex sign values and resolved-conjugate control
candidates.framework_gap: No transfer/offload action; upstream ROCm observation must be independently verified on NVIDIA.
candidates.expected_behavior: Explicit complex sign values and resolved-conjugate control

candidates.title: [CUDA] grid_sampler_2d backward: FP16/BF16 grad_grid accumulates in the input dtype
candidates.root_group: grid sampler low precision gradient accumulation
candidates.conditions: BF16 bilinear grid gradient summed over 2048 or 4096 channels
candidates.oracle: Analytic interior derivative and FP32 control
candidates.framework_gap: Low precision input generation and numerical property oracle absent; direct BF16 is not autocast.

validation_policy: One execution per issue, explicit fixed inputs, no RNG or timing races; controls and independent oracle required.
